Water Quality Data

Source: R/utils-data.R
wq_std.Rd

A filtered and formatted subset of the BC Gov water quality guidelines fetched with bcdata::bcdc_get_data(), from record 85d3990a-ec0a-4436-8ebd-150de3ba0747, and resource 6f32a85b-a3d9-44c3-9a14-15175eba25b6.

Usage

wq_std()

Value

tibble of formatted and filtered water quality guidelines

Details

This data is formatted for easier use in R (e.g., lower case columns names), and filtered to include only parameters for Drinking Water an looking at only the Upper Limits of the Maximum Acceptable Concentration. It is further filtered to only include parameters of interest to groundwater analyses.

Three columns, enmods_param, bcgwcat_param and n have been added to the data to reflect the corresponding parameter names in EnMoDS and bcgwcat, as well as to reflect how many different guidelines there are for a paraticular parameters (n).

wq_std()
